sql.if: AND ( name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%') OR email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%') OR REPLACE(phone, '-', '') LIKE CONCAT( '%', REPLACE(#{condition.keyword}, '-', ''), '%' ) )

mapper.select: SELECT id, name, email, phone, birth_date, status, created_at, withdrawn_at FROM members WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, name, nickname, email, phone, birth_date, role, status, created_at, updated_at, suspended_at, suspended_reason, withdrawn_at FROM members WHERE id = #{memberId}
SELECT id, email, password, nickname, role, status, created_at, updated_at, withdrawn_at, phone, name, birth_date FROM members WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members (email, password, nickname, role, name, created_at, phone, birth_date) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{role}, #{name}, NOW(), #{phone}, #{birthDate})
mapper.select: SELECT password FROM members WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND password IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE
